identity.semantics: for each bar index i, evaluate_setup03_event(quotes[:i+1], risk_capital, setup_parameters, decision_parameters)

ADJACENT_STABILITY_HIGH.rule: An adjacent pair is HIGH when exact-date Jaccard is at least 75% and retained/previous is at least 90%.
ADJACENT_STABILITY_HIGH.scope: descriptive evidence only; does not affect SETUP_03

ADJACENT_STABILITY_LOW.rule: An adjacent pair is LOW when either exact-date Jaccard is below 75% or retained/previous is below 90%.
ADJACENT_STABILITY_LOW.scope: descriptive evidence only; does not affect SETUP_03

CONCENTRATION_HIGH.rule: At any production tolerance and market aggregate, max single-symbol share is at least 10% or top-3 share is at least 30%.
CONCENTRATION_HIGH.scope: descriptive evidence only; does not affect SETUP_03

CROSS_MARKET_DIVERGENCE.rule: At 3%, 4%, or 5%, CN/US event-density or platform-density ratio is outside [0.80, 1.25], or zero-event-symbol difference is at least 2, or max-share difference is at least 5 percentage points.
CROSS_MARKET_DIVERGENCE.scope: descriptive evidence only; does not affect SETUP_03

NO_CLEAR_STRUCTURAL_PLATEAU.rule: Neither production transition 3%→4% nor 4%→5% is HIGH in the ALL aggregate.
NO_CLEAR_STRUCTURAL_PLATEAU.scope: descriptive evidence only; does not affect SETUP_03

SPARSE_AT_3.rule: At 3%, each CN and US market has at least 30% of symbols with 0, 1, or 2 confirmed events.
SPARSE_AT_3.scope: descriptive evidence only; does not affect SETUP_03

STRUCTURAL_EXPANSION_4_TO_5.rule: ALL confirmed events grow by at least 20%, platform density by at least 10%, and high-span median by at least 10% from 4% to 5%.
STRUCTURAL_EXPANSION_4_TO_5.scope: descriptive evidence only; does not affect SETUP_03
